references:
# 11-kaskad — Регион «Каскад»: референсы карт «Плотина» и «Сухое дно»

2 ноября 2026. Codex CLI (`codex exec`, встроенный image_gen), по три варианта на карту. Image1 — `ref-blocks-day-camera.png` (утверждённый двор: только камера, кадр и раскладка дорожки боя), Image2 — `ref-style-2-yard.png` (стиль 2).

## Общая часть каждого запроса

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE finished EMPTY playable environment plate for the game Crowned Dogs, portrait 9:16, 1882x3344 if possible. Image1 is a CAMERA AND LAYOUT reference only: copy its eye height, lens, horizon height, vanishing point and the open central combat lane running from the bottom centre deep into the scene; copy NOTHING of its buildings, bus or rocket. Image2 is the authoritative STYLE reference only: cold grey desaturated near-photoreal bodycam realism, believable rough PBR surfaces, restrained rust, weathered concrete, subdued cinematic exposure, no outlines, no cartoon or painterly treatment, no orange/teal grade. Perspective: stationary eye/bodycam about 2 metres high, vertical field of view about 55 degrees, ground horizon / vanishing point about 37% down the image and about 57% across. Keep the central combat lane open and walkable on DRY ground from the bottom centre deep into the distance, wide enough for two live 3D fighters standing 7 to 14 metres apart on one line: no big props in the central 40% of the image. Big landmarks stay at the sides and in the distance. Years of war are visible: shell craters, burned vehicles, small drones tangled in wires, old trenches, torn camouflage and anti-drone netting, rubble and junk; no bodies. Daytime, high hazy sun, pale grey sky, cool deep shadows, limited warm highlights. Strong natural perspective, no extreme fisheye, sharp materials. Empty scene: NO people, NO robots, NO combatants, NO detached weapons, NO foreground hands or rifle, NO targeting rings, NO HUD, NO text, NO numbers, NO logos, NO flags. This is an environment texture for a camera-projection game stage, not a screenshot. Region: «Kaskad», a reservoir and hydroelectric dam in a fictional post-Soviet province, the last big water of the region.
```

## Плотина (`dam`, предел 14 шагов, открыто)

A — гребень плотины:

```text
MAP: THE DAM, variant A, the dam crest road. The lane is the long straight concrete roadway along the top of a huge Soviet gravity dam, receding to the far bank. LEFT side: the upstream parapet and, beyond it, a wide grey reservoir far below with a pale low waterline; a row of tall concrete sluice-gate towers with a rusty travelling gantry crane spanning the road in the middle distance (high above the lane, legs at the road edges). RIGHT side: the downstream parapet with a steep drop to the spillway and the long low turbine hall roof far below; one wrecked anti-aircraft gun emplacement behind sandbags at the right roadside. Anti-drone nets hang sagging from poles along the road. Lamp posts, some bent. The roadway itself is dry cracked concrete with tyre marks and debris; water is only far below, never on the lane.
```

B — у турбинного зала:

```text
MAP: THE DAM, variant B, the downstream apron at the turbine hall. The lane is the dry concrete service apron at the foot of the dam. LEFT side: the tall battered facade of the Soviet turbine hall with huge broken ribbon windows, a rusty gantry crane on rails above its wall, cable trays and transformers. RIGHT side: a heavy concrete wall with the spillway chutes and the colossal grey dam face rising behind into the haze, dry stained concrete, only a thin trickle at a distant chute. A wrecked twin anti-aircraft gun on a burnt truck chassis at the right edge mid-distance, sandbag positions, anti-drone netting stretched on poles above the apron. Dry ground, no puddles on the lane.
```

C — сетка от дронов над гребнем:

```text
MAP: THE DAM, variant C, a netted crest. The lane is the dam crest roadway turned into a covered corridor: dense sagging anti-drone fishing nets stretched overhead on steel poles and cables from both parapets, light filtering through them in soft patterned shadows on the dry concrete. LEFT side: sluice-gate machinery houses and a rusted travelling crane. RIGHT side: the downstream parapet, through gaps the turbine hall and the dry river valley far below. A burnt-out armoured personnel carrier against the right parapet mid-distance, a destroyed anti-aircraft gun with drooping barrels further left near the gate towers, small drones caught in the nets. At the far end the crest continues to the far bank with power line pylons. Dry concrete lane, no water on it.
```

## Сухое дно (`dryBed`, предел 13 шагов)

A — баржа и катер:

```text
MAP: THE DRY BED, variant A, the drained reservoir floor. The lane runs across a vast flat bed of cracked grey-ochre dried silt with deep polygonal cracks, pale salt-white crust in the cracks, old shell craters. LEFT side: a huge rusted river cargo barge lying aground and listing, its hull towering, anchor chain trailing into the mud. RIGHT side: a smaller rusted motor boat and a half-buried patrol launch on its side. Steel power-line pylons (old Soviet lattice towers) march across the bed into the distance, one of them leaning, sagging wires with a small crashed drone tangled in them. Far in the background the grey concrete dam closes the valley under heat haze. Visible heat shimmer over the mud, dusty pale sky, oppressive dry heat. Dry ground only, no water.
```

B — коридор между корпусами:

```text
MAP: THE DRY BED, variant B, between the hulls. The lane runs on cracked dried silt between two stranded vessels: LEFT a long rusty tanker barge on the mud with a collapsed deck crane, RIGHT the high rusted bow of a river tug sitting upright, propeller exposed. Between and behind them more wrecks recede: a sunken pier on stilts now standing in dry mud, old fishing boats. A line of power-line pylons crosses the far bed toward the distant dam. Old trench and sandbags dug into the mud on the right foreground edge, torn camouflage net over a wreck. Heat haze blurs the far distance. Cracked mud with salt-white crust, no water.
```

C — опоры ЛЭП и затопленная деревня:

```text
MAP: THE DRY BED, variant C, the pylon field. A wide open flat of cracked dried silt. A row of very tall rusty lattice power-line pylons stands in the bed on concrete footings, receding along the RIGHT side; one pylon fallen across the far bed. LEFT side: the remains of a drowned village emerging from the mud: brick ruins, stumps of dead trees, a rusted boat stranded on a former street, and a small grey concrete pump station. Far background: the dam wall and a burned truck. Scattered shell craters, a crashed drone in the dry mud, heat shimmer over the ground, pale hazy sky. Dry ground only, no water.
```
